verdict.rationale: GitHub documents both a public REST API for creating integrations, retrieving data and automating workflows, and a GraphQL API for precise, flexible queries. Fine-grained personal access tokens scope API permissions, and the X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions response header reports which permissions an endpoint requires, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. An official CLI, an official MCP server and an llms.txt add further agent-friendly entry points. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (every probed docs path returned 404), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
